newsitem.title: USA: Sioux Falls cattle up $0.50 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Sioux Falls cattle up $0.50 - USDA.

text.p: USDA said slaughter steers and heifers traded $0.50 higher. Trading was moderately active.
Steers - two loads choice predominantly 3 1200-1400 lbs 70.00. High select and choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs 67.50-69.00. Select and choice 2-3 1100-1300 lbs 64.50-67.50. Select 1-2 61.50-64.50.
Heifers - load blacks choice predominantly 3 near 1225 lbs 70.00. High select and choice 2-3 1050-1200 lbs 66.50-69.00, package 69.50. Select and choice 2-3 1000-1125 lbs
